description: One small floor plant in a worn muted brown rectangular terracotta pot. Sparse drooping broad leaves on three thin brown stems; several leaves are partly withered with curled brown tips. Use only dull taupe and muted brown for the dying leaves, no bright green, no flowers. Thin open gaps between leaves, readable silhouette, no ground or external shadow. Strict native-resolution pixel art for DREAMS, abandoned fast-food dining hall with dark red booth seats and night forest windows. Match the approved cashier sprites: native one-pixel grid, restrained detail, front-facing side-scroller elevation, no isometric perspective. Dark plum-brown one-pixel outlines, desaturated slate metal, aged cream paper, muted taupe and faded burgundy accents; only the supplied twelve colors. Two or three flat local material tones. No lighting effects or directional shine, no gradients, anti-aliasing, dithering, blur, glow or external cast shadows. One isolated complete prop centered with transparent padding, hard opaque pixels and fully transparent exterior. No scene, background, floor, extra props, watermark or logo. Canvas exactly 32x48 native pixels.
